part.text: I’m comparing 8 p.m.–5:59 a.m. with 6 a.m.–7:59 p.m. The records can show crash frequency and reported injury/fatality outcomes, but they do not include traffic exposure, so they cannot measure risk per trip.

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+NIGHT = "Night (8pm–5:59am)"
+DAY = "Day (6am–7:59pm)"
+COLORS = ["#d97706", "#2563eb"]  # night, day
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+query = f"""
+WITH source AS (
+    SELECT *,
+        CASE WHEN hour(crash_time) >= 20 OR hour(crash_time) < 6
+             THEN '{NIGHT}' ELSE '{DAY}' END AS period
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA.as_posix()}')
+),
+date_span AS (
+    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crash_date) AS observed_dates FROM source
+),
+all_crashes AS (
+    SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS crash_count
+    FROM source
+    GROUP BY period
+),
+complete AS (
+    SELECT period,
+        COUNT(*) AS complete_crashes,
+        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_persons_killed > 0) AS fatal_crashes,
+        SUM(number_of_persons_injured) AS injured_people,
+        SUM(number_of_persons_killed) AS killed_people
+    FROM source
+    WHERE number_of_persons_injured IS NOT NULL
+      AND number_of_persons_killed IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY period
+)
+SELECT a.period, a.crash_count, d.observed_dates,
+       CASE WHEN a.period = '{NIGHT}' THEN 10 ELSE 14 END AS hours_per_day,
+       c.complete_crashes, c.fatal_crashes,
+       c.injured_people, c.killed_people
+FROM all_crashes a
+CROSS JOIN date_span d
+JOIN complete c USING (period)
+ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.period = '{NIGHT}' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
+"""
+df = con.execute(query).fetchdf()
+
+# Option 1: all police-reported crashes per elapsed clock hour in each time band.
+df["elapsed_hours"] = df["observed_dates"] * df["hours_per_day"]
+df["crashes_per_elapsed_hour"] = df["crash_count"] / df["elapsed_hours"]
+v1 = df[["period", "crash_count", "observed_dates", "hours_per_day", "elapsed_hours", "crashes_per_elapsed_hour"]]
+v1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 5.0))
+bars = ax.bar(["Night\n8pm–5:59am", "Day\n6am–7:59pm"], v1["crashes_per_elapsed_hour"], color=COLORS, width=.58)
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{v:.2f}" for v in v1["crashes_per_elapsed_hour"]], padding=5, fontsize=11)
+ax.set_ylabel("Police-reported crashes per elapsed clock hour")
+ax.set_title("Crash frequency is lower during nighttime hours")
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(v1["crashes_per_elapsed_hour"]) * 1.22)
+ax.text(.5, -.20, "Time bands use all dates in the file; daytime has 14 hours and nighttime 10.", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", fontsize=9)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Complete-case denominators are used for both reported injury/death outcomes.
+df["fatal_crashes_per_100k"] = df["fatal_crashes"] * 100000 / df["complete_crashes"]
+v2 = df[["period", "fatal_crashes", "complete_crashes", "fatal_crashes_per_100k"]]
+v2.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 5.0))
+y = [1, 0]
+vals = v2["fatal_crashes_per_100k"].tolist()
+ax.hlines(y, 0, vals, color=COLORS, linewidth=3, alpha=.55)
+ax.scatter(vals, y, color=COLORS, s=95, zorder=3)
+for yi, value in zip(y, vals):
+    ax.annotate(f"{value:.1f}", (value, yi), xytext=(8, 0), textcoords="offset points", va="center", fontsize=11)
+ax.set_yticks(y, ["Night (8pm–5:59am)", "Day (6am–7:59pm)"])
+ax.set_xlabel("Crashes with ≥1 person killed per 100,000 crashes")
+ax.set_title("A greater share of nighttime crashes involved a death")
+ax.set_xlim(0, max(vals) * 1.24)
+ax.text(.5, -.20, "Includes crashes with nonmissing injury and death counts.", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", fontsize=9)
+ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: report injury and death counts separately, stacked per 100 crashes.
+df["injuries_per_100_crashes"] = df["injured_people"] * 100 / df["complete_crashes"]
+df["deaths_per_100_crashes"] = df["killed_people"] * 100 / df["complete_crashes"]
+df["casualties_per_100_crashes"] = df["injuries_per_100_crashes"] + df["deaths_per_100_crashes"]
+v3 = df[["period", "complete_crashes", "injured_people", "killed_people", "injuries_per_100_crashes", "deaths_per_100_crashes", "casualties_per_100_crashes"]]
+v3.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 5.0))
+labels = ["Night\n8pm–5:59am", "Day\n6am–7:59pm"]
+injury = v3["injuries_per_100_crashes"].to_numpy()
+death = v3["deaths_per_100_crashes"].to_numpy()
+bars_i = ax.bar(labels, injury, color="#2563eb", label="People injured")
+bars_d = ax.bar(labels, death, bottom=injury, color="#7c3aed", label="People killed")
+for i, (b, total) in enumerate(zip(bars_d, v3["casualties_per_100_crashes"])):
+    ax.annotate(f"{total:.2f} total", (b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2, total), xytext=(0, 5), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", fontsize=10)
+ax.set_ylabel("People injured or killed per 100 crashes")
+ax.set_title("Nighttime crashes produced more reported casualties per crash")
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(v3["casualties_per_100_crashes"]) * 1.22)
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+ax.text(.5, -.20, "Complete cases only: crashes with nonmissing injury and death counts.", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", fontsize=9)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print("Observed dates:", int(df["observed_dates"].iloc[0]))
+print("Option 1 values:\n", v1.to_string(index=False))
+print("Option 2 values:\n", v2.to_string(index=False))
+print("Option 3 values:\n", v3.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
